test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Smriti greeted me and asked me where I was working then.

options.text: Smriti said to me, “Hello! Where you are working now?”
Smriti said to me, “Hello! Where I was working then?”
Smriti said to me, “Hello! Where are you working now?”
Smriti said to me, “Hello! Where were you working then?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Smriti said to me, “Hello! Where are you working now?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting indirect speech into direct speech:​
 
 
• The commas and inverted commas are added, and the reporting verb 'asked' will be replaced by 'said to'.
 
• The **full stop(.)** is **replaced by** the **question mark(?)**.
 
• The first-person pronoun 'I' will be changed into the second-person pronoun 'you'. Also, **'then' becomes 'now'**.
 
• The past continuous tense format 'Subject + was + V1(work) + ing + Object'&
